catalyst: CoreWeave's Q3 beat (sales +168% to $3.66bn, backlog $133bn) and raised FY26 outlook lifted the neocloud complex overnight, CRWV +15% and NBIS +11% pre-market; NBIS reports Q3 on 12 Nov

Q3 FY2026 results released 10 Nov after the close: record sales $271.7m (+28.5% y/y), operating income doubled to $54m, adjusted EBITDA $59.3m, aerospace backlog a record $670m - but Q4 revenue guidance of $255-275m came in below the $273.7m consensus, so shares fell in pre-market
no fresh catalyst found (no Coherent release; the pre-market bid tracked the AI and optical complex - Lumentum +9% pre-market - after CoreWeave's Q3 beat and the Microsoft transceiver-ban story)

NextNav Q3 2026 results released 10 Nov after the close: revenue $1.582m against a $0.993m consensus, a net loss of $4.2m (EPS -$0.02 vs -$0.12 est) partly offset by a $13m non-cash warrant-liability gain, about $290m of cash and investments and debt-free, with the FCC's P&T Notice of Proposed Rulemaking still in interagency review and the proposed SpaceX purchase of low-band spectrum cited as a scarcity precedent
Jefferies cut the price target to $10 from $12 (Buy kept) in an AI data-centre re-rating, and the pre-market gain came from CoreWeave's beat lifting AI-infrastructure names; no company release
